name: Me & Mrs Jones
beachAccess: On The Diamond in Portstewart town centre; no beach distance stated
confirmedFeatures: Wine bar serving food all day, public bar, beer garden, individually decorated rooms
overview: A boutique hotel on The Diamond in the centre of Portstewart, with 20 individually decorated double en-suite rooms. Downstairs there is a wine bar serving food through the day, a public bar and a beer garden. Portstewart Strand is a short drive or longer walk west along the coast, and Portrush is a few minutes away by car.
surfTripFit: Good for couples who want town-centre food and drink after a session at Portstewart Strand or Portrush.
